goal.description: Short walk goal (required). Also used as seed_query when seed_query omitted (auto/semantic_only).

seed_query.description: Optional semantic seed text (defaults to goal when omitted).

seed_atom_ids.description: Optional explicit durable atom ids to seed (point lookups).

seed_media_ids.description: Optional media attachment ids for multimodal semantic seed (att_…).

seed_mode.description: Seed policy. Default auto (anchor+dig dual temporal when semantic hits). Prefer semantic_only for focused associative enter; explicit_only for known-id maneuvers (moment bloom / context fan / time spine).

budgets.description: Optional budget overrides. Clamped to [1, HARD_MAX] (may raise above product defaults up to hard max).

include_noisy_kinds.description: When true, include tool/ledger/model atoms in local_map ring and edges. Default false: only sequential bridges to noisy kinds (bridge_noisy). Prefer speak/observation; set true only when goal needs noisy kinds.
